def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, np.inf)
    can_fit = bins >= item
    if np.any(can_fit):
        # For bins that can fit: priority = remaining capacity after insertion
        priority_scores[can_fit] = bins[can_fit] - item
    # Bins that cannot fit get infinite score (lowest priority)
    return priority_scores

algorithm: {Prioritize bins with the largest remaining capacity that can fit the item, then by largest original capacity for tie-breaking.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    can_fit = bins >= item
    if np.any(can_fit):
        remaining = bins[can_fit] - item
        priority_scores[can_fit] = -remaining
    return priority_scores
